title: Ginga Tokkyuu Milky☆Subway
titleNative: 銀河特急 ミルキー☆サブウェイ
synopsis: Chiharu the cyborg and Makina the cyborg are arrested for violating the Galactic Road Traffic Act. It was supposed to be a simple mission, but before long, they find themselves embroiled in a major incident. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
